report.explanation: Current telemetry contradicts the operator hypothesis: all sampled checkout traces return HTTP 200 across order, inventory, payment and postgres, and order metrics show 21.3 successful /v1/orders 200s with zero 502s. The only deployment record is baseline order 1.0.0 with no previous version, so it cannot establish a deployment-caused fault. No bounded cause is supported; logs were excluded and are needed.
missing_evidence: Order service logs (excluded from context) to check for errors or exceptions during the window
Error-rate or failure telemetry for checkout beyond the sampled successful traces
Deployment history showing any version change preceding the alert window
Any observed checkout error records to confirm the alert is real
